## Three months, one trend — read from DuckDB

The report folder holds a local `data/warehouse.duckdb` file. The chart below is populated by a read-only SQL query executed by the native host's `local-duckdb` connector.

```chart
type: bar
title: Orders increased from 120 to 180
data:
  sql:
    connector: local-duckdb
    query: queries/orders-by-month.sql
    cache:
      key: orders-by-month
      ttl: 1h
encoding:
  x: month
  y: orders
axes:
  x:
    label: Month
  y:
    label: Orders
```

*Source: fictional monthly orders in the local DuckDB warehouse.*

```callout
kind: neutral
title: Where the data comes from
body: "The SQL text, DuckDB connection and captured rows stay on the native host; the rendered HTML carries only the rows and a Data source note. The rows are captured when the report renders and this chart reuses them for an hour (`cache.ttl`). Without a `cache` they are reused until the query changes, and `cache: { refresh: true }` runs the query on every render."
```
